title: Izzat khuda ke deen
body:
izzat khuda ke deen ki bachali hussain ne
nana tumhari baat nibahyi hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun hai jo qaimon may jaa kar khabar kare
asghar ki qabr ran may banaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon pe pattiyan aap ne baandhi thi ay khaleel
kadiyal jawan ki laash uthaayi hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ro pade thay kamar apni thaam kar
dekha jo ghar batool ka khaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala may apna bhara ghar luta diya
lekin nabi ki baat na taali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sach to ye hai ke hurmat e islam ke liye
shariyat ki baag e dor sambhali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e khuda mohib jo andhere may ghir gaya
shamma hussaniyat ki jalaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
author: Mohib Fazli
